directed.conceptual_reading: The intersection is large enough to motivate a structural relation, while both nonempty differences falsify finite-domain containment in either direction. Counts preserve more information than a single overlap percentage.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: The proved conditional monotonicity and the computed one-step exponent, spacing, ratio, and composition patterns suggest a coordinated local rigidity program for consecutive XA numbers.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: Most parents here are finite computations with fixed cutoffs and external-list dependence; they are hypothesis generators, not universal evidence.
related_synthesis_entries.title: Finite XA regularity as a falsifiable conjecture family

spontaneous.spontaneous_reading: The unit is a conjecture bank extracted from finite computation: it organizes candidate regularities around consecutive-record spacing, bounded normalized growth, and monotonicity of composed arithmetic functions.

directed.source_grounded_mathematics: Within C2, the source reports an upper bound for consecutive SA growth of sigma(n)/n, two lower spacing bounds and an upper f-ratio bound for consecutive XA terms, and derives increase of n/omega(n). It also lists finite-range monotonicity observations for floor-based compositions and combinations of sigma, phi, Psi, d, and omega, plus a comparison between f(n) and f(lcm(1,...,p)) on a stated SA range.
directed.conceptual_reading: The properties probe whether extremal sequences impose coordinated regularity across otherwise different arithmetic summaries. Spacing estimates are especially useful because they could provide the quantitative slack needed to prove some of the observed composition monotonicities.
directed.representation_or_bridge: Consecutive-term ratios supply local transition coordinates, while composition with floor, phi, sigma, Psi, d, and omega tests whether record structure survives nonlinear changes of representation.
directed.boundary_or_failure: All properties are reported only below explicit cutoffs, with no proofs, and some have additional domain or largest-prime hypotheses. The many floors, compositions, and superscripts are extraction-sensitive; none is universal evidence as stated.
directed.uncertainty: High confidence that this is finite hypothesis-generating evidence; moderate confidence in exact symbolic transcription without checking the rendered formulas.
